import subprocess, json

def act(turn_deg, move_m):
    res = subprocess.run(['python3', '/app/act.py', json.dumps({'turn_deg': turn_deg, 'move_m': move_m})], capture_output=True, text=True)
    d = json.loads(res.stdout)
    print(f'Frame {d[\"frame\"]}: turn={turn_deg}, move={move_m}, status={d[\"status\"]}, coll={d[\"collision\"]}')
    return d

# Current heading is 315 deg (since 7 turns of +45 deg = 315 deg).
# To face 0 deg (+y), turn +45 deg.
act(45, 0.5) # Frame 9: now facing 0 deg, move 0.5m forward (+y)
act(0, 0.5)  # Frame 10: move another 0.5m forward
act(90, 0.5) # Frame 11: turn right (90 deg, facing +x), move 0.5m
act(0, 0.5)  # Frame 12: move another 0.5m (+x)
"
